description: Election Commission - Declare that W. W. Amarasena was Selected as the member of the Haliela Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Hali-ela Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the declaration of a selected member to fill a vacancy due to non-attendance, which falls under election-related administrative matters.
